payload.localInsight: Golf Course Road is dominated by premium salons like Studio 17 and Geetanjali (South Point Mall), which are highly accessible via the Gurgaon Rapid Metro. Local corporate professionals frequently complain about a lack of billing transparency and rushed, damaging bleaching treatments at these larger chains. Reviewers highly praise personalized, unhurried consultations that prioritize hair integrity over aggressive upselling.
payload.crowdInsight: Public discussions on r/gurgaon reveal a massive pain point: women feel 'posh' salons are overpriced and mediocre. Stylists frequently push expensive balayage and unnecessary bleaching when clients only want a rich, healthy global color, leading to fried hair and broken trust. There is a strong demand for honest, skilled colorists who offer transparent, upfront pricing.

copy.shotList: Beat 1: Slow push-in on an empty styling station with a minimalist cream leather chair under soft, warm light. Beat 2: Close-up of a premium amber glass bottle of hair protective serum resting on a dark stone counter. Beat 3: A soft ray of afternoon sunlight shifting across a textured warm paper wall with subtle gold accents.
copy.primaryText: Tired of rushed salon appointments and forced, damaging bleach treatments? At NOYA, we craft rich, healthy global hair colour tailored to your lifestyle with complete billing transparency. Your hair integrity is our only priority.
copy.storyHook: The rushed, over-bleached conveyor belt of Golf Course Road chain salons remixed into an unhurried, single-chair color ritual that respects your hair's integrity.
copy.subhead: Experience unhurried consultations and transparent pricing at DLF Phase IV.

prompts.image: A refined, 16:9 cinematic photograph of an empty, high-end hair salon interior. A single minimalist styling chair upholstered in premium cream leather faces a large round backlit mirror. On a dark charcoal counter sits a single amber glass bottle of hair treatment. The color palette is composed of warm paper cream, deep charcoal, and soft gold accents. Meticulous composition, elegant lighting, no people, no hands, no faces, no text.
prompts.veo: Cinematic interior film, 8 seconds, 9:16 aspect ratio, slow camera push. A luxurious and empty boutique hair salon interior in Gurgaon with a refined minimalist aesthetic. Centered is a single high-end cream leather styling chair in front of a large circular mirror with soft backlit illumination. The room features a warm paper-cream palette and dark charcoal accents. No people, no hands, no faces, no on-screen text. Quiet, ambient room tone.
prompts.story: 9:16 vertical still photograph of a minimalist salon styling station, safe-zoned in the center third. A sleek, empty styling chair in cream leather sits before a polished stone vanity. The background is a textured wall in a warm paper-cream tone. Refined, calm atmosphere, elegant soft lighting, brand palette of cream and dark charcoal, no people, no hands, no faces, no text.
prompts.detail: A detailed 1:1 macro still photograph of a premium dark glass bottle of hair serum resting on a textured cream paper surface next to a gold-accented ceramic mixing bowl. Clean, professional composition, soft side lighting highlighting the product's premium glass texture. Brand palette of dark charcoal, cream, and warm dark brown. No people, no hands, no faces, no text.
prompts.lyria: A serene, minimalist 2-second ambient acoustic guitar pluck, ending in a warm, resonant decay. No vocals.

final.text: Meticulous global colour. No rushed bleaching.

judge.reason: The ad copy contains no medical claims, guaranteed outcomes, or invented testimonials. The English and Hindi translations are consistent, professional, and focus on service quality and billing transparency for a local salon SMB.
